name: SLV Technical Analysis Dashboard
description: Near-term technical analysis for Silver Trust (SLV) using standard technical indicators to assess momentum, trend, and volatility
source:
# Data source
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l
volume = src.v

# =============================================================================
# TECHNICAL INDICATORS
# =============================================================================

# RSI (14-period)
rsi_14 = rsi(period=14)(close)

# MACD (12, 26, 9)
macd_line, macd_signal, macd_hist = macd(short_period=12, long_period=26, signal_period=9)(close)

# Moving Averages
sma_20 = ma(period=20, type=MAType.sma)(close)
sma_50 = ma(period=50, type=MAType.sma)(close)
sma_200 = ma(period=200, type=MAType.sma)(close)

# Bollinger Bands (20-period, 2 stddev)
bb_lower, bb_middle, bb_upper = bbands(period=20, stddev=2)(close)

# ATR (14-period)
atr_14 = atr(period=14)()

# =============================================================================
# CALCULATED METRICS
# =============================================================================

# Daily change percentage
daily_change_pct = (close - (close >> 1)) / (close >> 1)

# Price distance from moving averages (as percentage)
dist_from_50ma = (close - sma_50) / sma_50
dist_from_200ma = (close - sma_200) / sma_200

# =============================================================================
# EVENT MARKERS - SIGNALS
# =============================================================================

# RSI signals
rsi_oversold = rsi_14 < 30
rsi_overbought = rsi_14 > 70

# MACD crossover signals
macd_bullish_cross = crossover(macd_line, macd_signal)
macd_bearish_cross = crossunder(macd_line, macd_signal)

# =============================================================================
# DASHBOARD CARDS
# =============================================================================

cards(
    layout=CardLayout(
        title="Technical Overview",
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Current RSI", card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title="Price vs 50-Day MA", card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Price vs 200-Day MA", card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category="Summary"
)(rsi_14, dist_from_50ma, dist_from_200ma)

# =============================================================================
# DASHBOARD TABLE
# =============================================================================

detailed_table(
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title="Recent Price Summary",
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Close", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Daily Change %", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="RSI", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title="MACD", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="50MA Distance", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category="Data"
)(close, daily_change_pct, rsi_14, macd_line, dist_from_50ma)

# =============================================================================
# DASHBOARD CHARTS
# =============================================================================

# Price with Moving Averages and Bollinger Bands
timeseries_lines(
    title="SLV Price with Moving Averages",
    category="Charts",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Close", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="20-Day SMA", color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="50-Day SMA", color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="200-Day SMA", color=Color.Red),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="BB Upper", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="BB Lower", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(close, sma_20, sma_50, sma_200, bb_upper, bb_lower)

# RSI Indicator
timeseries_lines(
    title="RSI Indicator",
    category="Charts",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="RSI (14)", color=Color.Purple)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=30, title="Oversold", color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=70, title="Overbought", color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=50, title="Neutral", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ])
)(rsi_14)

# MACD Indicator
timeseries_lines(
    title="MACD Indicator",
    category="Charts",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="MACD Line", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Signal Line", color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Histogram", color=Color.Gray)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title="Zero", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(macd_line, macd_signal, macd_hist)

# Volume Chart
timeseries_lines(
    title="Volume",
    category="Charts",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Volume", color=Color.Cyan)
    ]),
    area=True
)(volume)

# =============================================================================
# EVENT MARKERS
# =============================================================================

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="RSI Oversold",
        icon=Icon.TrendingDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="RSI", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title="Close", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Is Oversold", table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(rsi_14, close, rsi_oversold)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="RSI Overbought",
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="RSI", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title="Close", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Is Overbought", table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(rsi_14, close, rsi_overbought)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="MACD Bullish Cross",
        icon=Icon.ArrowUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="MACD", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="Signal", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="Close", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Is Bullish Cross", table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(macd_line, macd_signal, close, macd_bullish_cross)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="MACD Bearish Cross",
        icon=Icon.ArrowDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="MACD", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="Signal", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="Close", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Is Bearish Cross", table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(macd_line, macd_signal, close, macd_bearish_cross)
